name: Kagami
source:
A Kaen 3rd year student from Gekkougumi. Appears in Himeutsugi-hen—a beautiful woman dressed as a man. In contrast to Himeutsugi, she is a woman and acts as a 'prince'.
She is Himeutsugi's minamo and the daughter of the president of JinJa TV station and takes on TV-related jobs while still a student to take over the TV station.

[Translated from the [url=https://ja.wikipedia.org/wiki/%E8%8F%AF%E3%82%A2%E3%83%AF%E3%82%BB]wikipedia[/url]]
